description: The History of al-Tabari (Ta'rikh al-rusul wa'l-muluk), SUNY Press annotated translation in 40 volumes, plus A. I. Akram's The Muslim Conquest of Persia. All in copyright: output stays in content/private/ (gitignored). Source PDFs live outside the repo; set BOOKS_DIR to their folder.
author: Abu Ja'far Muhammad b. Jarir al-Tabari
